data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for runtime app self-protection and threat monitoring on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: It detects root/jailbreak, compromised bootloaders, hooking frameworks, UI automation attacks, and other security threats, providing a weekly security report and API protection features.
use_when: You need runtime protection against reverse engineering or tampering
You require cross-platform threat monitoring without external services
You want to enforce app integrity checks on the backend
avoid_when: Your app is small and security is not a concern
You already use a dedicated security solution that covers these checks
strengths: Comprehensive threat detection across Android and iOS
Provides weekly security reports and detailed incident data
weaknesses: Integration requires native configuration and permissions
Documentation is scattered across multiple sites
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, configure AndroidManifest and Info.plist, request necessary permissions, and follow the integration guide on docs.talsec.app
